title.zh: 行商舰队：拜金教团：最后提议
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Numistic Order: Last Call

excerpt.zh: 错失一次投资的机会，那将会是你犯下最大的错误，我的朋友。你确定你能承担放弃我们提议的代价吗？这是在我们离开你的领地之前的最后机会。
excerpt.en: A missed opportunity to invest, my friend, is the most expensive mistake you will ever make. Are you certain you can afford to pass up on our offer? This is your last chance before we depart your territory.

title.zh: 行商舰队：拜金教团：最后提议
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Numistic Order: Last Call

texts.zh: 错失一次投资的机会，那将会是你犯下最大的错误，我的朋友。你确定你能承担放弃我们提议的代价吗？这是在我们离开你的领地之前的最后机会。
texts.en: A missed opportunity to invest, my friend, is the most expensive mistake you will ever make. Are you certain you can afford to pass up on our offer? This is your last chance before we depart your territory.

texts.zh: 奴玛是一位大方的女士。我们正要离开时她提醒了我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！一定要在我们离开之前给他们一生中最后一次机会！
texts.en: Numa is a generous mistress. We were about to leave when she reminded us - the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! They must have one last chance at the deal of a lifetime, before we leave!

texts.zh:
往往在某些小选择中，你的命运就已注定。在这投资一点，在那儿投资一点，终有一天会变成一笔巨大的收益。小小的水滴终将汇聚成为海洋。

命运让我们在离开之前再给你一次选择的机会。
texts.en:
It is in the little moments your fate is decided. A credit well spent here, a credit there, will one day make a million. Small streams meet to make an ocean.

Fate has given you one more chance to take our offer before we leave.

texts.zh:
啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你听到奴玛的召唤了吗？我们马上就要离开你们的领地了，但首先，请问你们考虑过我们的交易了吗？

好好想想吧，这也许是让你飞黄腾达的选择，否则就走向毁灭，你会如何选择？
texts.en:
Ah, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], do you hear Numa calling? Soon we must depart your lands, but first, have you considered our offer?

Weigh your options well, for one may set you on a path to great fortune. Another to ruin. Which will it be?

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们很快将会离开你的领地。我们将会让宇宙中的能量币指引我们前进。你考虑过我们的提议了吗？
texts.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Soon we will depart your territory. We must go wherever the current of cosmic energy credits takes us. Have you considered our offer?

responses.zh: 祝福你，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你我之间的交易让我们离奴玛更近了。
responses.en: Blessings upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for your business brings us closer to the goddess.
